card.name: Inside the word Oriental and its forms
card.fires_on: The word Oriental or its pieces (Orient, Oriental, Orientals, Orientalism) in non-drug text, firing on the ending or the capitalised word itself. Seen in writing on Jewish history, birds and insects.

modes.label: Ending after Orient
modes.description: The pole responds to the ending piece (al, als, ental) that completes Orient or Ori-ental.
modes.example: orient<<al>> cockroaches cannot climb up smooth surfaces

modes.label: Capitalised Oriental
modes.description: The pole responds to the whole word Oriental, as a name or adjective, including Orientalism or Orientalists.
modes.example: will reveal<< Oriental>> Skylark and Variable Wheatear.
